blocks.heading: How to Judge Any Course Before Paying

items.text: 1 Instructor credibility and recency Has the instructor done real, current work in this field, and was the course meaningfully updated in the last year or two.
2 Syllabus depth versus the job posting Open two or three live job postings for your target role before enrolling.
3 A practical output, not just video hours Does the course end in something you built, a dashboard, a model, a working query set, not just a certificate of completion.
Where an official, recognised exam exists for a skill, weigh it above an unofficial equivalent course, even if the unofficial one is cheaper.
5 A free or cheap way to test it first Almost every course on this page has a free audit option, a free tier, or a heavily discounted sale price.
